name: Thelgen Rock
summary: Thelgen Rock is an extensive cavern system cut into the southern mountain wall of the Wetlands. Infested with venomous spiders, it is notorious for harboring rare veins of volatile Incendicite Ore.

sections.title: A Web-Choked Cavern
sections.body: Nestled against the southern mountains separating the Wetlands from Loch Modan, Thelgen Rock is a deep subterranean cave network overrun by aggressive arachnids. The passages are thick with webs and crawling with poisonous spiders that make entering the caverns extremely hazardous for travelers. Despite the infestation, miners and adventurers brave its depths for the valuable deposits of Incendicite Ore found embedded in the rocky tunnels.

faq.answer: The caverns of Thelgen Rock are densely inhabited by large, poisonous spiders. Travelers who venture into the winding tunnels can easily find themselves cornered and overwhelmed by venomous bites amidst the webs.

faq.q: Why do prospectors and miners come here?
faq.answer: The cave system contains rich seams of Incendicite Ore, a fiery and volatile mineral sought after by dwarven prospectors and engineers. Despite the spider infestation, daring miners enter to harvest samples from the cave walls.
Thelgen Rock lies along the southern mountain ridge of the Wetlands, south of the main road that connects Menethil Harbor to the Dun Algaz mountain pass.

angles.text: The deep tunnels of Thelgen Rock house rare deposits of Incendicite Ore, drawing prospectors into danger beneath the mountain.
